scope: Local single-owner runtime hardening; not public multi-user release certification or independent scientific validation.
runtime_checks: A second process cannot own the same resolved runtime directory.
Lock release after normal exit and process termination.
Symbolic/hard-linked lock targets rejected without modifying target.
Atomic job-write failure preserves committed metadata and removes only its temporary file.
Imports do not mark live jobs interrupted.
Startup recovery is explicit, durable and idempotent.
Invalid job records are preserved and reported.
Shutdown drains the worker even when job metadata cannot be written.
Repeated application lifespan recreates its worker pool.
Final live health: 0.8.1, runtime_owner=true, zero storage warnings, 15 saved completed jobs retained.
